===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=time period|:inh|enm:day|tree=1}}
{{inh+|en|enm|day}}, from {{inh|en|ang|dæġ}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*dag}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*dagaz|t=day}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*dʰegʷʰ-|t=to burn}}.
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|sco|day}}, {{m|sco|dei}}, {{m|sco|dey}}, {{m|sco|dy|t=day}}, {{cog|yol|daie}}, {{m|yol|dei}}, {{m|yol|dey}}, {{m|yol|die|t=day}}, {{cog|frr|dai}}, {{m|frr|doi}}, {{m|frr|däi|t=day}}, {{cog|stq|Dai|t=day}}, {{cog|fy|dei|t=day}}, {{cog|bar|Dåg}}, {{m|bar|Tåg|t=day}}, {{cog|gmw-cfr|Daach|t=day}}, {{cog|cim|tag}}, {{m|cim|tage|t=day}}, {{cog|nl|dag}}, {{m|nl|dagge|t=day}}, {{cog|de|Tag|t=day}}, {{cog|nds-de|Dag}}, {{m|nds|Dagg|t=day}}, {{cog|li|Daach}}, {{m|li|Daag|t=day}}, {{cog|lb|Dag|t=day}}, {{cog|mhn|ta|t=day}}, {{cog|wym|taog|t=day}}, {{cog|vls|dag|t=day}}, {{cog|yi|טאָג|t=day}}, {{cog|da,nb,nn,sv|dag|t=day}}, {{cog|fo,is|dagur|t=day}}, {{cog|nrn|dagh|t=day}}, {{cog|gme-cgo|tag|t=day}}, {{cog|got|𐌳𐌰𐌲𐍃|t=day}}, {{cog|xvn|*dag-|t=day}}; also {{cog|br|deviñ|t=to burn}}, {{cog|kw|dewi|t=to kindle}}, {{cog|ga|daigh|t=fire, flame}}, {{m|ga|dóigh|t=to burn, singe; sear, scorch}}, {{cog|gv|daah|t=to scorch, singe; to cauterize}}, {{cog|gd|dòth|t=scorch, singe; burn}}, {{cog|cy|deifio|t=to scorch, singe}}, {{cog|la|foveō|t=to warm, keep warm}}, {{cog|el|τέφρα|t=ash, cinder}}, {{cog|sq|dhez}}, {{m|sq|ndez|t=to kindle, light}}, {{cog|prg|dagis|t=summer}}, {{cog|hy|հրդեհ|t=fire}}, {{cog|sa|दह्|t=to burn, consume by fire, scorch, roast}}.

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# The time when the [[Sun]] is above the [[horizon]] and it lights the sky.
#: {{syn|en|daylight|Thesaurus:daytime}}
#: {{ant|en|night|Thesaurus:nighttime}}
#: {{ux|en|'''day''' and night;  I work at night and sleep during the '''day'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=8|passage=The '''day''' was cool and snappy for August, and the Rise all green with a lavish nature. Now we plunged into a deep shade with the boughs lacing each other overhead, and crossed dainty, rustic bridges over the cold trout-streams,{{nb...}}.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q573}} A period of time equal or almost equal to a full day-[[night]] [[cycle]], being 24 hours long.
#: {{alti|en|mul:d<id:Q573><qq:symbol>}}
#: {{syn|en|twenty-four hour day|24-hour day|;|nychthemeron<qq:uncommon>}}
#: {{hol|en|week<id:Q23387>|<|megasecond<id:Q1197459>|<|fortnight<id:Q2993680>|<|month<id:Q5151>|<|year<id:Q577>|<|gigasecond<id:Q1377051>|<|century<id:Q578>|<|kiloannum<id:Q3013059>|kiloyear<id:Q3013059>|millennium<id:Q36507>|<|terasecond<id:Q1322380>|<|mega-annum<id:Q20764>|megayear<id:Q20764>|<|petasecond<id:Q1066138>|<|giga-annum<id:Q524410>|gigayear<id:Q524410>|<|exasecond<id:Q906223>|<|zettasecond<id:Q12011178>|<|yottasecond<id:Q14913554>|<|ronnasecond<id:Q122972375>|<|quettasecond<id:Q116939356>}}
#: {{mer|en|quectosecond<id:Q125387265>|<|rontosecond<id:Q125387281>|<|yoctosecond<id:Q2762458>|<|zeptosecond<id:Q1872619>|<|attosecond<id:Q2483628>|<|femtosecond<id:Q1777507>|<|picosecond<id:Q3902709>|<|nanosecond<id:Q838801>|<|microsecond<id:Q842015>|<|millisecond<id:Q723733>|<|centisecond<id:Q3249364>|<|decisecond<id:Q3251645>|<|second<id:Q11574>|<|decasecond<id:Q1040401>|<|minute<id:Q7727>|<|hectosecond<id:Q1040427>|<|kilosecond<id:Q1374438>|<|hour<id:Q25235>}}
#: {{ux|en|I've been here for two '''days''' and a bit.}}
## The time taken for the Sun to seem to be in the same place in the sky twice; a [[solar day]].
## The time taken for the Earth to make a full rotation about its [[axis]] with respect to the fixed stars; a [[sidereal day]] or [[stellar day]].
# {{lb|en|informal|or|meteorology}} A 24-hour period beginning at 6am or sunrise.
#: {{ux|en|Your 8am forecast: The high for the '''day''' will be 30 and the low, before dawn, will be 10.}}
# A period of time between two set times which mark the beginning and the end of day in a [[calendar]], such as from [[midnight]] to the following [[midnight]] or {{lb|en|Judaism}} from [[nightfall]] to  the following [[nightfall]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:day}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''day''' begins at midnight.}}
#: {{ux|en|Monday is the first '''day''' of the week in many countries of the world.}}
# {{lb|en|astronomy}} The rotational period of a planet.
#: {{ux|en|A '''day''' on Mars is slightly over 24 hours.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:National Geographic|year=1990|month=August|volume=178|number=2|title=Neptune: Voyager's Last Picture Show|author=Rick Gore|page=39
|text=Radio emissions indicate that a Neptunian '''day''' lasts 16.1 hours, an hour and a half shorter than previously thought.}}
# The part of a day period which one spends at one’s job, school, etc.
#: {{ux|en|I worked two '''days''' last week.}}
#* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=7|passage=“{{...}}if you call my duds a ‘livery’ again there'll be trouble. It's bad enough to go around togged out like a life saver on a drill '''day''', but I can stand that 'cause I'm paid for it. What I won't stand is to have them togs called a livery.{{nb...}}”}}
# An [[observance]] lasting for a day, such as an [[annual]] [[holiday]].
#: {{coi|en|Christmas '''Day'''}}
#: {{coi|en|Remembrance '''Day'''}}
# A day set aside for a specified [[activity]].
#: {{co|en|leg '''day''', moving '''day''', observation '''day'''}}
# {{senseid|en|era}} A specified time or period; time, considered with reference to the existence or prominence of a person or thing; [[age]]; {{l|en|time|id=era}}; {{l|en|era#Noun}}.
#: {{syn|en|era|epoch|Thesaurus:era}}
#: {{ux|en|every dog has its '''day''';  in that '''day''';  back in the '''day'''; in those '''days'''}}
#* {{RQ:Hough Purchase Price|chapter=I|text=This new-comer was a man who in any company would have seemed striking.{{...}}Indeed, all his features were in large mold, like the man himself, as though he had come from a '''day''' when skin garments made the proper garb of men.}}
#* {{RQ:Orwell Animal Farm|6
|passage=If they had no more food than they had had in Jones's '''day''', at least they did not have less.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=w:Kat Martin|title=''A Song for My Mother''|publisher=Vanguard Press|isbn=9781593156565|url={{gbooks|aDz9AgAAQBAJ|200|day}}|passage=In his senior year, he had run across an old '66 Chevy Super Sport headed for the junkyard, bought it for a song, and overhauled it with his dad's help, turning it into the big red muscle car it was back in its '''day'''.}}
# A period of [[contention]] of a day or less.
#: {{ux|en|The '''day''' belonged to the Allies.}}
